question: Which airport received the Platinum Recognition in the Green Airports Recognition 2025 by ACI?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hubballi Airport.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Hubballi Airport in Karnataka received the prestigious Platinum Recognition in the Green Airports Recognition 2025 by Airports Council International (ACI) Asia-Pacific and Middle East.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The award was given in the category of "Sustainable Energy at Airports" for airports handling fewer than six million passengers annually.**
 
• Hubballi Airport commissioned an innovative 8 MW solar power plant in December 2022.
 
• The solar plant supplies clean energy to Hubballi, Belagavi, and Mysuru airports, with future expansion planned.
 
• The plant is expected to reduce carbon emissions by about 215,000 tonnes over its lifetime.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Airports Council International (ACI)**__: A global trade representative of the world’s airports promoting cooperation and excellence in airport operations and sustainability.
 
• __**Green Airports Recognition**__: Recognizes airports' outstanding efforts in minimizing environmental impacts through sustainable practices.
 
• __**Airports Authority of India (AAI)**__: Oversees the development and management of airports in India and promotes green infrastructure initiatives.
 
• __**Significance**__: Highlights India's commitment towards achieving net-zero carbon emissions through sustainable airport operations.
